mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL above 237.5 triggers investor concerns about inflation persistence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 237.5, or the 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in GDP demand pressure equity valuations, signaling recessionary expectations and negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO during a late-cycle expansion signals weakening business investment and capacity utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive in > 60% of late-cycle instances despite INDPRO declines, or the 60-day IC is above 0.05 in such regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength and economic resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to rise in > 60% of instances with PAYEMS growth, or the 20-day IC is below 0.03 in expanding labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 5.0% signals tight labor markets and reduced inflationary pressures, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE falling below 5.0, or the 5-day IC is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand growth (GDPC1) and aggressive monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS) signal overvaluation and risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high demand and high rates, or the interaction effect IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in HOUST during a late-cycle expansion signals weakening industrial demand and capacity pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 60% of late-cycle instances despite HOUST declines, or the 60-day IC is above 0.05 in such regimes.
